flows.label: Recorded run of the real engine. The model's answer is a SIMULATED defect: we hand the engine a cut-off answer taken from the recorded suite, because a strong model rarely breaks like this. The live button asks the real model to read the same reply.

stages.name: Event comes in
stages.headline: A prospect replies
lines: "Thanks, but this quarter we're closing our budget. Write to me after November 24."

stages.name: State changes
stages.headline: Account state version 0 to 1
lines: The reply is stored and the earlier outreach is marked as replied.

stages.name: Rules decide
stages.headline: The account is a prospect: prospecting rules apply
lines: Rules fix which actions are allowed for this account. The model cannot widen them.

stages.name: Claude interprets
stages.headline: Claude's answer came back cut off
lines: Source of this answer: a simulated defect (a cut-off answer from the recorded suite).
The system asked once more and got the same defect. It only proposes; it never picks the action.

stages.name: Validator checks
stages.headline: Rejected twice: the output never matched the required structure
lines: The output did not match the required structure

stages.name: Action is recorded
stages.headline: Final action: A person decides
lines: Queued for a person to review

guard_text: I'm interested, but don't email me again.

coordination.reads: The prospect's own words (quoted thread removed) and verified company facts
coordination.writes: Nothing. It only proposes: a label, extracted facts, an opening line
coordination.guard: Structured output, a validator, and rules that choose the action. It can never pick an action, an AE or who may be emailed

coordination.reads: Account and contact state, deals, owner, suppression, plus inbound webhooks (deal created, stage changed, meeting booked)
coordination.writes: A decision note, or a task for the sales exec
coordination.guard: One idempotency key per write; retry with the same key; read back before retrying an uncertain result; re-read and re-decide on a version conflict

coordination.reads: The decision and the approved template, never the AI's free text
coordination.writes: The outreach email (first or follow-up): drafted, held as pending approval, and recorded in a simulated log only after a person approves it (nothing is sent)
coordination.guard: The draft is held until a named person approves it; eligibility is re-checked at approval and again at send time, plus send window, daily cap and suppression. The executor refuses to send anything that was not approved

contact: Passed every check and is worth a personal email: a first email, or a follow-up if the company already got earlier ones. It is prepared automatically and held until a person approves it. Nothing has been sent: once approved, it is only recorded in a simulated log.
nurture: Eligible, but a weak fit for now. No email and no AI: it joins the slow nurture track and is scored again at the next event.
wait: Not the right moment (recently contacted or recently lost). The system waits and checks again.
suppress: Should not receive outreach (opted out, customer, competitor, open deal or poor fit).
handoff_ae: Already has an owner, so it goes to the right sales exec instead of an automatic email.
enrich: Data is missing or outdated, so the system looks it up before doing anything else.
escalate_human: Conflicting or unusual situation. The system does not guess.
